results.desc: Please give a warm welcome back to the label to Simon Vuarambon who brings us 2 amazing tracks here. Metro is a collaborative rework with the legend that is Josh Wink and Grey Area is a much sought after solo outing, this tracks have been both been getting plenty of attention on dance floors across the summer months.
results.name: Metro / Grey Area

results.desc: After Ruggier, fellow Argentinian rising talent Zaren is now taking the lead on the TNT field. As always, gloomy, minimal, booming beats push the groove to the limit on his 'Solo' EP, which also features a collaboration with AMC. Please note that this explosive material requires care during transport and use.
results.name: Solo EP
